title: Project
description: Groups items toward a deliverable (design part 3.2). In the files backend the body holds the sections Why, Done when, Plan and Notes; this schema covers the front matter. Derived fields (claimed, ready, blocked, stage, critical_path, lead_time) are never stored.

owner.description: The human accountable, if not the project owner.

opened_from.description: Signal, opportunity or decision IDs this was opened from.
